title: Doesn't work for my shower caddy.
text:
Doesn't work for my shower caddy.. Unfortunately this is the same style that came with the shower caddy. The caddy doesn't lay flat against the wall so these suction cups don't touch the wall. The caddy style is great, I just need connectors that have a hook, I hope.

[[ASIN:B016AFTUYK mDesign Bathroom Hose Shower Caddy for Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap - Silver]]

product_metadata.title: Better Houseware Shower Caddy Connectors Suction Cups - Professional Strength Large Suction Cups for Bathroom – 2-Piece Set - Easy to Attach & Transparent – Multipurpose Design
features: WHAT YOU NEED: Tired of always having to deal with slippery shower caddy problems? Would you like to solve this problem without having to spend your money, time and energy? The Better Houseware caddy connector set is the perfect solution!

COMPLETE SET: This shower caddy connector kit includes two large suction cups measuring 1” x 1.5” and a C-shaped piece for holding your shower pipe and head, everything you need for a neat and simple experience!

STURDY & STRONG: Made from premium quality, ultra-durable materials, these professional strength suction cups for caddy will ensure a sturdy and stable grip, keeping your shower caddy in place for a long time!

USER-FRIENDLY: Say goodbye to expensive handymen, complicated tools and wasted energy with these highly practical shower caddy connectors! With a user-friendly installation system, you’ll be done within seconds!

WIDELY COMPATIBLE: These shower suction cups can be used on all sorts of flat surfaces and perfectly smooth walls, including tiles, marble or glass. Make sure to properly clean the tile, preferably with alcohol before applying the cups for a stronger grip!
